info.text:
# Hades 2 Rogue

Hades 2 Rogue is an implementation of Hades 2 for Archipelago that aims to strip away most of the meta-progression of the base game, and instead replace it with Archipelago randomization. No Cauldron, no planting, no prophecies, just the more gameplay aspects with a whole lot of randomization.

This means that, based on configuration, every form of meaningful progression can be randomized. Your core locations will be making progress in routes; and you can configure defeating new enemies, meeting new NPCs, and gaining new Keepsakes to be locations as well.

Items are configurable, but can include: Max Grasp, Arcanas, Weapons, Aspects, Pets, Progressive Region Unlocks, unlocking helpers, and even unlocking gods themselves. Your goal is to defeat bosses, configurable in the YAML.

Additionally, this mod has support for Zagreus' Journey, a mod by NikkelM that allows Melinoë to fight through Zagreus' path from the first game; this only works if you have Zagreus' Journey downloaded and Hades 1 installed, do not enable those settings otherwise.

tutorials.text:
# Hades 2 Rogue Setup Guide



## Required Software

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)

- [r2modman](https://thunderstore.io/c/riskofrain2/p/ebkr/r2modman/) (or a similar mod launcher for Thunderstore)

- The Hades2Rogue [APWorld](https://github.com/BrittisH39/Hades2Archipelago/releases)

- The Hades2Rogue [mod](https://thunderstore.io/c/hades-ii/p/BrittisH39/Hades2RogueArchipelago/) (installed via r2modman)



## Optional
- An installation of Hades 1 will allow you to utilize the Zagreus' Journey mod made by NikkelM to include some original Hades 1 content in your Hades 2 game. This includes the original route, some NPCs, and some keepsakes. Zagreus' Journey is no longer a dependency of the AP mod, so it won't be downloaded automatically. If you want that content, search for and download "Zagreus Journey" in r2modman, on the same profile as the AP mod.



## Installation

### Mod

- Install and launch [r2modman](https://thunderstore.io/c/riskofrain2/p/ebkr/r2modman/).
- Find and select Hades 2. Select which store you own Hades 2 on. (Epic Games Launcher untested at this time)
- Select or create a profile (name doesn't matter).
- Select Online on the left side, then search for and find "Hades2RogueArchipelago".

- Select download, then download with dependencies. This also downloads the other mods it needs (Hell2Modding, and zerp's NPCRoomRandomizer, Extended NPC Encounters, and DreamDiveTweaks).



### APWorld

- Launch [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases).
- Drag and drop the [APWorld](https://github.com/BrittisH39/Hades2Archipelago/releases) onto the Archipelago window.
- Close and relaunch Archipelago.



## Configuring Your YAML

- Runs are designed to be possible regardless of your YAML settings, but it's recommended not to set maximum vows unless you are very confident in your Hades 2 skills. You will start the game with nothing, and the logic is set to believe you can at least make it to the boss of each region you have access to.
- DO NOT enable Zagreus' Journey unless you have downloaded the Zagreus' Journey mod, and have Hades 1 installed in the same location you have Hades 2 installed in; alternatively you can use the Zagreus' Journey config in r2modman to point to your Hades 1 installation.



## Connecting to a Game

- Launch Archipelago, and launch the Hades 2 Rogue Client.
- Put in the server you're connecting to and the port at the top (example: Archipelago.gg:45829). Hit connect.
- Enter your slot name when it asks for it.
- Once connected, hit "Launch Modded" in r2modman.
- Launch into a save, ensure the client says "Game connected to Bridge", and enjoy!



## For Troubleshooting/Issue Reports

- Visit the Hades 2 Rogue thread found [here](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1521929337954238624).

readme.text:
# Hades 2 Archipelago

Hades 2 implementation for the Archipelago Multiworld Randomizer - Created by BrittisH39 with AI assistance.



Windows only at this time



## **Setup**

#### 

#### **Mod**

* Install [r2modman](https://thunderstore.io/c/riskofrain2/p/ebkr/r2modman/)
* Launch, then find and select Hades 2. Select which store you own Hades 2 on (Epic Games Launcher untested at this time)
* Select or create a profile.
* Select online on the left side, and search and find "Hades2RogueArchipelago"
* Select download, then Download with Dependencies
* Zagreus Journey is no longer a dependency, so it won't be downloaded automatically. If you want the Hades 1 content, search for and download "Zagreus Journey" by NikkelM on the same profile. It only works if you have Hades 1 installed.



#### **APWorld/Hades 2 Client**

* Download the APWorld from the releases tab
* Download and install [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en) if you haven't already



**Then EITHER**

* Open the Archipelago Launcher
* Click and drag the Hades2Rogue.apworld file onto the Archipelago Window
* It will give you a confirmation message, relaunch Archipelago, and you're done.

**OR**

* Open you Archipelago installation
* Find the "Custom\_worlds" folder
* Place the Hades2Rogue.apworld file into that folder



* Search for the Hades 2 Rogue Client in the archipelago launcher
* Launch, connect to a server, select your slot.
* Launch the game with mods from r2modman
* Start a NEW SAVE
* You should be good to go!



# **Notes**



I consider this to be stable, but you will still likely run into a few bugs or issues. Please let me know if you do. Additionally I would love to hear any thoughts or ideas you have; the [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1375345291926044722) is the best way to share those.

Zagreus Journey is no longer a dependency for the mod. If you still have it downloaded from an older version and you don't have Hades 1, it will pop-up and tell you it's not installed correctly. As long as you turned off (Or left off) Zagreus Journey in the YAML, you can ignore this.

notes.text:
## Biggest changes:
- Enemy_locations replaced with Enemysanity option, which allows players to shuffle or randomize enemies in addition to setting them as locations. The shuffle and random modes are still experimental, so expect some major bugs if you select those options.
- Dream route added! Along with options to make it feel unique. Shoutout to zerp and their DreamDiveTweaks mod for allowing runs to go past 4 regions.
- Added progressive_per to Keepsakesanity and Petsanity, which adds progressive checks for each individual keepsake/pet.
- Minibosses aren't shuffled like normal enemies. Instead include_minibosses shuffles the miniboss rooms, so you might walk into a miniboss room in Erebus and find Charybdis.
- Room locations are now numbered per region instead of per route, and defeating a region's boss sends any room locations you have left in that region.
- Added Chaos to GodSanity.
- Chaos Gates can now show up in every region of the Underworld and Surface, instead of only a few.
- Reworked the Hades 2 tab in the client. It now shows your progress through each region, your goal progress, and lists of what you've checked. It also no longer relies on color to tell you things.
- Reworked DeathLink so deaths no longer queue up.

## Other Changes:
- Legendary and Duo boons are now more likely with more rarity increases.
- NPCs that spawn in different ways should now send their keepsakes regardless of where you give them nectar.
- Tried to fix some issues with when the Daedalus Upgrade item is applying.
- Fixed location issues in Fields of Mourning and Tartarus. Primarily that Fields of Mourning wasn't sending locations for each encounter, instead only sending them when you walk through the door. Tartarus was only sending locations when completing a bonus side room.
- Fixed players who had things set up incorrectly being permanently locked out of checks. Once the issue is corrected, locations should send as normal.
- Overlay now notes who you received items from.
- Attempted suppression of some camera takeovers when first entering the Crossroads hub. I will be working on this more as I catch more.
- Tried a really simple fix to hopefully stop armor from continuing to show as the screen blacks out during deaths.
- Zagreus Journey failed to install correctly message should now be suppressed if players have Zagreus Journey disabled in the YAML.
- Split Met and Defeated checks for Scylla and the Sirens into Scylla, Roxy, and Jetty.
- Added a seed-identity guard so starting a new Archipelago without closing the game shouldn't ever send locations from a previous archipelago connection.
- Chaos Gates should now count as rooms, since my previous assumption that they were extra is not correct.
- Room counter should now always show the room you're in instead of the last room you sent.
- Removed the hide and seek locations, and suppressed that flashback from ever happening.
- Vow of Menace can now pull enemies from regions you haven't visited yet.
- Suppressed all resource-gathering spots since there isn't a way to use them in the AP, and I don't intend to use them for anything.
- Suppressed the "Divination of the Elements" pop-up the first time a player collects a boon.
- Added 0.10.0 stuff to the Guided YAML and YAML Creator.
- Fixed an issue where Nightmare route was still locked until an unlock was sent even if players disabled lock_routes.
- Made ZJ an optional dependency. It's no longer downloaded with the mod, so if you want the Nightmare route, download it yourself in r2modman.
- DreamDiveTweaks is now a dependency, and is downloaded with the mod.
- Fixed room locations not sending if a later room in that region had already been sent by someone else (a collect, a release, or an admin).
- Room logic is more forgiving, the last rooms of a region aren't expected until you can beat its boss.
- Fixed per_aspect_room_based with combine_pools not creating any aspect room locations.
- Final Challenge now ends the run right after the victory screen when you defeat Zagreus, and fixed a few issues with where the Zagreus contract sent you afterwards.
- Fixed a crash in GodSanity when a boon was offered while you had no gods unlocked.
- Fixed gods you hadn't unlocked yet showing up in the first room of Ephyra.
- Fixed Daedalus Hammers rarely showing up in runs with GodSanity.
- Fixed some Starting NPC gifts not doing anything.
- Grasp can no longer be bought at the altar, since it comes from items.
- Helper story rooms should no longer show up as the very first room of a Nightmare region.
- Keepsake and Met locations can all be sent from a Dream Dive.
- If you win while the client is disconnected, the win is now saved and sent once you reconnect.
- start_inventory_from_pool now works with Grasp, Arcana, Keepsakes, and Vow Removals.
- Setting a filler's percentage to 0 now actually means you get none of it. Nectar was sneaking in anyway.
- Item and location IDs are now locked in place, so future updates shouldn't break seeds generated on older versions.
- The Surface door now opens as soon as you receive access to it, instead of needing to leave the room and come back.
- Fixed a crash that could happen when a combat helper showed up somewhere they normally don't.
- Fixed a rare case where the same room could repeat forever.
- With combine_pools, the shared pool is no longer sent early when your goal needs more than one route.
- Fixed some option combinations failing to generate correctly.
- Fixed Universal Tracker not counting some items towards logic.
